key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued Tsunami Alert Level 3 calling for immediate evacuation of coastal areas.
Coastal barangays in Leyte and Eastern Samar evacuated; surveys estimate about 80% of residents moved to safe places.
No significant tsunami waves observed and no damages reported.
Warning dissemination suffered delays and outages; in parts of Guiuan alerts arrived after expected wave time.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred east of the southern tip of Eastern Samar.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3… Like the Chile earthquake… caused only a very small wave and no damages.
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
missing_information: Precise list of all impacted municipalities beyond Guiuan not detailed.
No quantified damage or casualty figures (none reported).
